snippet.title: Tree Kingdoms - Announce trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3477080/Tree_Kingdoms/

Winter approaches, Great Spirit. Rival Tree Kingdoms peck at your borders... Will you conquer, outlast, or outwit them in this bite-sized turn-based 4X struggle? Command your Treelings, adapt to the seasons, and etch your legend into the bark of history, before the cold claims all.

BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/biscuitfactorygames.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/biscuitfactorygames/
